seo.home.title: Free Private File Tools, No Upload
seo.home.description: Convert HEIC, compress images, edit PDFs, make QR codes, and more right in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, no sign-up, and it works offline.
seo.convert.title: HEIC to JPG & Image Converter, No Upload
seo.convert.description: Convert HEIC, WEBP, AVIF, PNG, GIF, BMP, and SVG to JPG, PNG, or WEBP in bulk. Free, private, and done in your browser without uploading.
seo.compress.title: Compress Images Online, Free & Private
seo.compress.description: Shrink JPG, PNG, and WEBP file size, cap dimensions, and strip GPS and EXIF data. Compress hundreds of photos at once without uploading them.
seo.resize.title: Resize Images for Instagram & YouTube
seo.resize.description: Resize photos to exact Instagram post, Story, YouTube, or custom sizes. Crop to fill or keep the whole photo on a blurred background. No upload.
seo.crop.title: Crop & Rotate Images Online, No Upload
seo.crop.description: Crop photos to Instagram, YouTube, or passport photo ratios, rotate in 90° steps, and flip them. Free and private, right in your browser.
seo.merge.title: Merge Images Into One Picture, Free
seo.merge.description: Combine photos vertically or side by side into a single image, with optional spacing and background color. Free and private, nothing is uploaded.
seo.watermark.title: Add a Watermark to Photos in Bulk
seo.watermark.description: Stamp text or your logo on many photos at once: in a corner, centered, or tiled across the image. Free and private, done in your browser.
seo.ocr.title: Image to Text (OCR) Online, No Upload
seo.ocr.description: Extract text from screenshots, photos, and scanned pages in English or Indonesian. Recognition runs on your device, so images never leave it.
seo.icons.title: Favicon & App Icon Generator, Free
seo.icons.description: Turn one image into a full favicon set, Apple touch icon, Android icons, and web manifest, with the HTML to paste. Free and private.
seo.metadata.title: Remove Photo Metadata & GPS Location
seo.metadata.description: See what your photos reveal, such as camera, date, and GPS location, then strip it without losing quality. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
seo.color.title: Color Converter & Contrast Checker
seo.color.description: Convert colors between HEX, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH, check WCAG contrast, and pull a color palette from any photo. Free and runs in your browser.
seo.pdf.title: Free PDF Tools: Merge, Compress, Sign
seo.pdf.description: Turn images into PDF, PDF pages into images, merge, compress, reorder, number, sign, and password-protect PDFs without uploading them.
seo.markdown.title: Online Markdown Editor with Preview
seo.markdown.description: Write Markdown with a live side-by-side preview and formatting toolbar, then export to .md, HTML, or PDF. Your draft stays in this browser.
seo.qr.title: QR Code Generator & Scanner, Free
seo.qr.description: Create QR codes for links, text, or Wi-Fi, and read QR codes from photos. Free, no sign-up, and everything stays on your device.
seo.data.title: Convert JSON, CSV & YAML Online
seo.data.description: Convert between JSON, CSV, and YAML with a live preview, then copy or download the result. Free, private, and works offline in your browser.
seo.text.title: Word Counter & Case Converter Online
seo.text.description: Count words and characters, estimate reading time, change letter case, and clean up lines of text. Free, private, and instant in your browser.
